ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: The Impact of Light on Health

fullPassage:
Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.

However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light.

In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night. This improves people's cognitive abilities and overall mental health.

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 본문의 핵심 내용 파악 문제.
det.analysis:
① 햇빛은 비타민 D 수치를 높인다 — 본문 1문단과 일치 ✅
② 세로토닌은 뇌에서 생성되는 자연 화학물질이다 — 일치 ✅
③ 청색광은 멜라토닌 수치를 높여 수면을 돕는다 — 본문과 반대! 청색광은 멜라토닌을 '낮춰' 수면을 '방해' ❌
④ 적색 빛은 우리 몸에 영향을 미칠 가능성이 가장 적다 — 일치 ✅
det.tip: ③이 부적합합니다. 청색광은 멜라토닌을 '낮추어' 수면을 '방해'합니다.

적색과 황색 빛은 우리 몸에 영향을 미칠 가능성이 가장 적다.

④ 청색광에 의해 증가한다 — 본문과 반대, 청색광은 멜라토닌을 낮춤 ❌

questions.passage:
Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.

However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light.

In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night. This improves people's cognitive abilities and overall mental health.
questions.stem:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.
Blue and white light ①energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by ②lowering levels of melatonin. In contrast, red and yellow light are the ③less likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light can improve mental health by ④increasing the release of melatonin.

det.korean: the + 최상급: the least likely — 3개 이상 비교에서 최상급을 사용합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① energize: 주어 Blue and white light(복수) + 동사 energize, 적절
✅ ② lowering: 전치사 by 뒤 동명사, 적절
❌ ③ less → least: the ____ likely에서 최상급이 필요. less는 비교급
✅ ④ increasing: 전치사 by 뒤 동명사, 적절
det.tip: the least likely: 가장 ~할 가능성이 적은 — the + 최상급 구조를 확인하세요.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중, 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.
Sunlight ⓐ offers numerous health benefits. It boosts vitamin D levels, ⓑ makes the bones stronger, and heals skin conditions. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and ⓒ reducing depression. Reductions in sunlight are ⓓ linked to panic attacks.

det.korean: to promote와 병렬 구조: to promote happiness and reduce depression — to 뒤에 동사원형이 and로 병렬 연결됩니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ⓐ offers: 주어 Sunlight(단수) + 동사, 적절
✅ ⓑ makes: 병렬 구조(boosts, makes, heals), 적절
❌ ⓒ reducing → reduce: to promote ... and reduce — to 뒤 병렬 구조
✅ ⓓ linked: be linked to, 적절
det.tip: to + V1 and V2: to promote and reduce — and 앞뒤 동사원형이 병렬됩니다.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
The passage suggests that the relationship between blue light and melatonin is __________ the relationship between red light and melatonin.

det.korean: 본문은 청색광과 멜라토닌의 관계가 적색 빛과 멜라토닌의 관계와 __________임을 시사한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① opposite to: 청색광은 멜라토닌 ↓, 적색 빛은 멜라토닌 ↑ → 반대 관계
❌ ② the same as: 반대 효과이므로 틀림
❌ ③ unrelated to: 둘 다 멜라토닌에 영향
❌ ④ stronger than: 강도 비교가 아닌 방향 비교
det.tip: blue light → melatonin ↓ vs red light → melatonin ↑ — 정반대 관계입니다.
